Training

Learn automation control step by step: a short theory section followed by a self-corrected exercise at each stage, directly simulable in Studomate.

How it works

Short theory

Each step explains one concept in a few lines, no unnecessary jargon.

Self-corrected exercise

A mini-project to complete directly in the app, in your browser, no account or install needed.

Solution to compare

A simulable solution comes with every summary assignment: compare your solution against ours by simulating it.
